'''Gunda Mabin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] who worked as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Mabin began her career as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] when she was nine, working for the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]]. After working as a pirate for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Mabin had earned the nickname "Gunda the Terrible" and operated a small fleet of heavily-armed [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. She would rob her victims of everything they had, before selling any survivors into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. As a result, a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was placed on her head by the authorities in the [[Perinn sector/Legends|Perinn sector]] and a number of criminal organizations became angered by actions she had taken against them.

==Behind the scenes==
In Mabin's image in the sourcebook ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', she is depicted with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] sheathed on her belt. Strangely, no mention of the lightsaber is made in her history nor her character statistics.
